arms.A: fixed 0.5 admission prior; fixed walk preference under current native restrictions
arms.C: adaptive receipt counts with bounded within-family duration interpolation
arms.C_exact: same adaptive data as C, exact contexts only
arms.C_frozen_pool: same interpolation as C, frozen warmup data

primary_endpoint: paired mean common-request Brier on four unseen-duration interpolation cases; C below B and C_exact
secondary_endpoint: C versus C_frozen_pool isolates added verified experience
transfer_rule: pool only same source/action/posture/sleep/fatigue/pain/external family; at least 3 consistent labels at at least 2 distinct durations; interpolate only within observed duration hull
guards: unchanged native guards; source-pinned verified SQLite SelfModel only; no canonical checkpoint or external API
rejection_criteria: transfer outside duration hull or across source/safety/sensory context
limitations: Designed deterministic software fixtures, three order seeds rather than independent bodies. Hand-authored invariance assumption; no broad generalization, physical gait or consciousness inference. Prior Sprint results were inspected; this protocol is prospective for this new implementation only.
